binding_contract: Future job writes bound.json with explicit absolute argv/cwd/prefix/env per slot, runtime/source/fixture byte identities and real preflight commands and retained byte evidence. No approval boolean. Independent review follows capture.
binding_schema: Native future binding must include roots {engine, runtime, input, ground_truth, pairs, evidence}, tokens, trusted_PATH, runtime_files, runtime_versions, distributions, node_archive, preflight map and slots. Preflight map keys are runtime/<name> and <slot id>/<git query index>; each contains exact argv,cwd, signed exit_code, stdout/stderr byte identities. Fixture git command output comparison is byte-exact. Parent HOME is copied unchanged into child env if present; no other parent fields inherited.
